name: Motion sensors as a side channel
plain: Motion sensors can pick up nearby speech and typing taps.
meaning: Gyroscope and accelerometer pick up speaker vibrations and taps, letting a research app recover digits or speech with no mic permission. This is why Android 12 capped the rate.

android.note: Rate cap 200 Hz since 12 (API 31) unless declared

ios.api_surface: Safari asks for a motion permission since iOS 12.2.

limits.headline: Can maybe pick up nearby speech or typing taps from motion sensors, in research
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when an app or page collects fast motion data
can: Collect motion data at a high rate
Look for patterns that match taps or nearby speech
Guess a few spoken words or tapped keys in lab tests
cannot: Collect above 200 times a second on Android 12 and newer without declaring it
Get Safari motion data on iPhone without a permission since iOS 12.2
Match a real microphone for quality
Work well in noisy daily use; it is mostly a lab result
limits.differs: Android 12 caps the rate at 200 Hz unless declared. Safari on iPhone asks for a motion permission.

story.what_it_is: Researchers showed that motion sensors can pick up nearby speech and typing taps.
story.for_you: You would not notice it. Your phone sits on a table and its motion chip feels tiny shakes from your voice or your typing. A rogue app could guess some words or digits without ever asking for the microphone.
story.for_makers: Honest makers have no use for it. It matters because it shows a side door around the mic permission. Android 12 limited how fast sensors can be read, and iPhone prompts for motion on websites.

use_cases.example: A research app guessed spoken digits from the gyroscope on a phone lying on a desk (the Gyrophone work).
Researchers recovered PIN taps from motion data while the person typed on a banking app.
A game that must read motion at high speed could in theory pick up speech, which is why speed is capped.
A company bans unknown apps on phones used in sensitive meetings, in case sensors pick up speech.
Voice control tools prefer the mic, since the sensor is too weak and noisy for real use.
A platform engineer tests a rate cap to see how far it cuts the leakage.

risks: Speech or PIN inference without the mic
story.android_note: Android 12 caps motion sensor speed to 200 Hz unless an app gets a special permission.
story.ios_note: iPhone limits raw motion on web pages and asks the person for permission on Safari.

technical_bounds: Accuracy limited by the sample rate cap

abuse: Speech or PIN inference without mic

history.change: 200 Hz cap added to limit eavesdropping
